name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard bilateral NDA created by a committee of over 40 attorneys. Covers mutual confidentiality obligations between two parties sharing proprietary information.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Cover page template for the Common Paper Mutual NDA. Captures deal-specific variables such as party names, effective date, and governing law that are incorporated by reference into the standard terms.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys representing technology vendors, procurement teams, boutique firms, and Big Law.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Standard agreement for early-stage product partnerships. Governs the relationship between a company and a design partner who tests and provides feedback on a product before its full commercial launch.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard service level agreement designed to be used with the Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement (CSA). Defines uptime commitments, remedies, and measurement methodology for cloud services.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard agreement for professional services engagements. Covers the terms for delivering consulting, implementation, or other professional services including SOW structure, deliverables, and payment.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Standard agreement covering data processing obligations and privacy compliance. Addresses GDPR and other data protection requirements between a data controller and a data processor.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard agreement for licensing software to customers. Covers subscription terms, usage rights, restrictions, and support obligations for on-premise or hosted software products.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard agreement for business partnerships. Governs the terms of a commercial partnership including roles, revenue sharing, intellectual property, and termination.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-term agreement enabling a prospective customer to evaluate a product or service before committing to a full commercial contract. Defines the scope, duration, and terms of the pilot period.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Standard HIPAA-compliant agreement between a covered entity and a business associate. Governs the handling, use, and disclosure of protected health information (PHI) as required by HIPAA.

name: AI Addendum
description: Standard addendum covering AI-specific terms and obligations. Addresses the use of artificial intelligence tools and services, including data usage, model training restrictions, and AI-related liability.
